verdict.rationale: Skyfire lets a seller register individual services via 'Create Service' (name, type, pricing, identity requirements) which then become discoverable via the Directory and the MCP server's 'find-sellers' tool, so basic seller listing exists. But there's no documented bulk catalog feed or import API for merchants with many SKUs — creation is one service at a time and gated behind manual 'Submit for approval,' not a self-serve catalog sync mechanism. missing for 10: bulk/batch catalog import or feed API, machine-readable catalog schema (e.g. product feed spec), and automated/self-serve approval or sync workflow for large catalogs.
